shared_elements: low relief carving on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving organised in some horizontal banding, with anthropomorphic imagery and circular disc motifs, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a single massive frontal figure/statue with a few large isolated emblems (discs, hanging pendants) on its body, whereas B shows long processional rows of many identical profile figures in file, in stacked registers separated by rosette borders — different subject, different composition, different conventions.
